pages.title: The Mighty Sword
pages.text: The $(6)Mighty Sword$(0) is an ancient broadsword discovered within $(3)Ancient City$(0) treasure chests.$(br2)Its immense cutting weight remains dormant until exposed to royal perfume essences carried by the monarch of the catacombs: $(4)The Skeleton King$(0).

pages.title: Summoning the King
pages.text: 1. Retrieve the $(6)Skeleton Crown$(0) from $(5)End City$(0) treasure vaults.$(br)2. Build a vertical T-altar using $(8)4 Bone Blocks$(0) (1 base, 1 center, 2 lateral arms), matching a Wither altar.$(br)3. Right-click the center bone block with the $(6)Skeleton Crown$(0).$(br2)Soul fire detonates the structure, consuming the crown and summoning the $(4)Skeleton King$(0)!

pages.title: Monarch Drops & Skills
pages.text: Slaying the $(4)Skeleton King$(0) yields $(5)Quantum Jah Semiconductors$(0) and 4 $(d)Royal Perfumes$(0) that awaken the Mighty Sword in the $(b)Transmutation Cube$(0):$(br2)• $(d)Cherche$(0) -> $(6)Shellbust Stab$(0)$(br)• $(e)Salty Rage$(0) -> $(6)Blastar Punch$(0)$(br)• $(5)Chantage$(0) -> $(6)Hellcry Punch$(0)$(br)• $(b)Setiemson$(0) -> $(6)Icewolf Bite$(0)

pages.title: Shellbust Stab
pages.text: Transmuted with $(d)Cherche Perfume$(0) + Mighty Sword in the Cube.$(br2)Unleashes a devastating armor-piercing thrust that fractures tough chitin, enemy shields, and boss armor plates.

pages.title: Blastar Punch
pages.text: Transmuted with $(e)Salty Rage Perfume$(0) + Mighty Sword in the Cube.$(br2)Ignites an explosive fiery kinetic blast, erupting into a violent conflagration that incinerates surrounding targets.

pages.title: Hellcry Punch
pages.text: Transmuted with $(5)Chantage Perfume$(0) + Mighty Sword in the Cube.$(br2)Releases an unholy sonic death-wail that disorients, weakens, and heavily debuffs surrounding enemies.

pages.title: Icewolf Bite
pages.text: Transmuted with $(b)Setiemson Perfume$(0) + Mighty Sword in the Cube.$(br2)Summons ethereal frost wolf fangs to bite foes, freezing them solid in crystalline permafrost.
